note: Promotion to the tracked schema is out of scope: Trade School's 47 themes each name exactly one row at the single adult-route grade "11–12 · adult", not a five-band ladder, so this fills description only through the unbanded mechanism (v0.96.0, prompt 3 continuation, the second pack reached after apply_promotions()'s grade filter was extended from BAND_LEVEL to GRADE_LEVEL in v0.95.0). track/code/level stay as they were (LB-<n> codes, level derived structurally by light_fill()).
